newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BMT EXPECTS HIGHER 1997 SALES, PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: BMT EXPECTS HIGHER 1997 SALES, PROFITS.

text.p: Belgian engineering group BMT said in its 1996 annual report it expected sales and profits to rise in 1997.
"BMT hopes to realise turnover of around 5.6 billion Belgian francs in 1997. We also expect this slight rise in turnover to be accompanied by a parallel rise in profitability."
BMT's 1996 consolidated net profit including minority interests rose 25 percent to 253 million francs on sales of 5.45 billion francs.
BMT was due to hold its annual shareholders meeting on Thursday.
BMT is 10 percent owned by Flemish regional investment company GIMV, due to float on the Brussels Stock Exchange next month.
